task.title: P6-154: Make rail's pinned All cards row link to the table, not /my, in mobile drawer
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Visual and layout). Original id: P6-154. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**The rail's pinned `All cards` row links to `/my`, so tapping it inside the mobile drawer lands on the root list rather than the table** (was `P6-021c`; `tree.rs:266-274`, shared with the mobile drawer) — two taps to reach the aggregate, and the drawer's own row appears to do nothing. A CSS switch cannot change an `href`.
